risk_areas.name: Persistence formats and migrations
questions: How is existing data migrated? Can an older version still read the data after a downgrade?

risk_areas.name: Permissions and authentication
questions: Which entry points are affected? Does an action the user starts by hand get a new block?

risk_areas.name: Billing, quotas and entitlements
questions: How does it behave for existing users and when the quota runs out?

risk_areas.name: CI and release configuration
questions: Can this change weaken existing checks or release safeguards?

risk_areas.name: API contracts
questions: Can old and new clients and servers still work together?
